name: sub2api
description: A Cloudflare-based LLM gateway and proxy server: the CLIProxyAPI (CPA) project deployed as a Cloudflare Worker in one click.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password for the dashboard sign-in at /login. Use a long random string, for example `openssl rand -base64 30`.

MANAGEMENT_KEY.description: CPA management key, asked for inside the dashboard. At least 32 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -, for example `openssl rand -hex 32`. Used on first start only; change it in the dashboard afterwards.
